result.title: Chance-Constrained Personalized LLM Routing with Online Preference Learning
result.summary: We study personalized LLM routing, where a router selects among heterogeneous models with different costs and capabilities. The router must minimize cumulative inference cost while ensuring reliable realized response quality, even though user preferences are unknown and must be learned from feedback during deployment. We formulate this problem as a constrained contextual bandit and develop an algorithm that learns preferences while balancing cost and quality. Under a logistic preference model and a strict-feasibility condition, we establish sublinear expected cost regret relative to an optimal stationary randomized contextual oracle and a high-probability guarantee on realized cumulative satisfaction. The framework extends beyond LLM routing to broader online model-selection problems with reliability requirements.

AI.brief_summary: 研究个性化 LLM 路由问题：在用户偏好未知、只能靠部署期反馈学习的前提下，把异构模型间的选择形式化为带约束的上下文 bandit，并给出兼顾成本最小化与实现质量可靠性的算法及亚线性遗憾、满意度保证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「成本—可靠性约束下的在线模型选择」可能与 LVR 的动态计算分配、THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡及停止决策存在概念联系，可供核查约束式 bandit 形式化与在线偏好学习能否迁移到推理期计算调度，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
